author: (C. B. Adams, 1852)

note.en: A small hard-shelled basket clam of sandy bottoms off Cahuita; two museum samples. The catalogue lists it as Corbula caribaea.
note.es: Una almeja pequeña de concha dura de fondos arenosos frente a Cahuita; dos muestras de museo. El catálogo la cita como Corbula caribaea.

evidence: GBIF: 2 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica (REGAMA and Cahuita catalogue), Avicennia

recWhy: Record: A small hard-shelled basket clam of sandy bottoms off Cahuita.
